summary: Iteration 8 verified. Backend: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_8_legal_analytics_stripe.py = 19/19 pass + 2 Stripe checkout tests skipped due to missing STRIPE_SECRET_KEY env var. Full regression (iteration_4/5/6/7) = 77/77 pass — zero regressions. Legal v2.0.0 verified (STRICT NO-REFUND, Mumbai arbitration, Consumer Protection Act 2019). Terms enforcement verified: fresh v2 users can create Razorpay orders/subscriptions; v1 users get 428 TERMS_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED and unblock after /api/profile/accept-terms. Anonymous analytics /api/analytics/track (scan + retailer_click), auto-fire from /api/products/lookup, /api/admin/analytics/overview totals + top_products (Organic Rolled Oats) + retailer breakdown + CSV export all work. Non-admin gets 403 on overview. Stripe status/toggle flow: status returns enabled=false with reason='free_until_admin_enables' when prices are zero; after admin toggle to $2/$20 the status flips enabled=true — but /api/payments/stripe/checkout returns **503 'Stripe is not configured yet'** because backend/.env has no STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (only STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent is injected by the platform). Fuzzy dedup schema (kind ∈ {exact, fuzzy}, confidence 0-100, exact=100) validated on empty cluster list. Frontend: /legal/terms shows Version 2.0.0 header + STRICT NO-REFUND, NO-CANCELLATION POLICY; TermsGate modal appears for v1 users on login (tested by resetting veriscan-test@example.com to v1 in Mongo then logging in) — tapping testID='terms-gate-accept' dismisses the modal after POST /api/profile/accept-terms; /admin/analytics fully renders stat cards + retailer bar chart + top products + 14-day activity for authenticated admin.

When an unauthenticated visitor opens /admin/analytics, the screen renders header + 'Refreshing…' spinner forever with 3x 401 console errors. There is no 'Admin only' guard or redirect. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/analytics.tsx:23-38

Either (a) rename os.environ.get('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY', '') → os.environ.get('STRIPE_API_KEY') in /app/backend/routes/stripe_payments.py, or (b) add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=<test key> to /app/backend/.env. Currently /api/payments/stripe/checkout is unusable in the deployed env.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/stripe_payments.py correctly gates checkout on TERMS+PRIVACY v2 (428 when stale), correctly returns enabled=false with reason='free_until_admin_enables' while prices are zero, and correctly requires provider='stripe' — the only blocker is the env-var name.

routes/analytics.py is well-designed: no PII stored, single $inc per event, per-key (barcode/retailer) counters, cross-key retailer|barcode counter for future drill-downs, aggregation pipelines correctly scope by date range, admin_user dependency enforces role. record() wrapped in try/except so analytics never breaks UX.
routes/profile.py accept-terms + terms-status endpoints are minimal and correct; terms-status short-circuits registered=false for anonymous which lets the TermsGate stay hidden for guests.

legal_content.py TERMS_VERSION=2.0.0/PRIVACY_VERSION=2.0.0 with all required clauses present (STRICT NO-REFUND, Arbitration in Mumbai, Consumer Protection Act 2019, EU/UK/India withdrawal-right waiver, aggregate cap INR 500 / USD 6 / 3 months, class-action waiver).
routes/payments.py razorpay/order and razorpay/subscription correctly return 428 when versions mismatch — verified end-to-end.

routes/payments.py admin/duplicates now unions exact clusters (kind='exact', confidence=100) with rapidfuzz fuzzy clusters (kind='fuzzy', score_cutoff=82, same category) — schema verified; empty result on this DB is expected because seeded catalogue has no near-duplicates.

frontend TermsGate.tsx uses Modal (correct RN component) with testIDs on accept + view-terms + view-privacy; blocks navigation via full-screen Modal until acceptance succeeds. Logic (`data?.registered && !data.up_to_date`) is correct.

rca_of_issue: Stripe 503: /app/backend/routes/stripe_payments.py:34 reads STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, but the container environment injects STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent. When the admin toggles a country to a positive price and a user with valid T&C acceptance calls /api/payments/stripe/checkout, _stripe_key() raises HTTPException(503, 'Stripe is not configured yet') before any Stripe SDK call is made. Fix in one line: change the env-var lookup to STRIPE_API_KEY (or add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY to backend/.env). All other Stripe endpoints (status, toggle) are unaffected because they never call _stripe_key().
